definition: Raw width=sample SD(S/Etrue)/mean; calibrated width=sample SD(Ecal/Etrue)/mean; all generated events retained
tail_definition: Pr(Ecal/Etrue<0.5); raw comparator uses training-only cross-fit scale S/R0; not unscaled silicon fraction

crossfit.secondary_prior: inverse true energy in training only

bootstrap.method: joint whole-event multiplicities with fixed IDfolds; full preprocessing/innerselection/outermodel refit
bootstrap.interval: approximate pointwise95% percentile; includes training uncertainty

baseline.inference_inputs: Persisted cell energies/positions/IDs and fixed physical masks only; no truth energy/direction
baseline.mask_probe: Gaussian transverse widths5.5/11/22mm,5x5 samples; fixed longitudinal Gaussian centre16,width8layers; analysis probes only

staggered.inference_inputs: Persisted cell energies/positions/IDs and fixed physical masks only; no truth energy/direction
staggered.mask_probe: Gaussian transverse widths5.5/11/22mm,5x5 samples; fixed longitudinal Gaussian centre16,width8layers; analysis probes only
